notes.title: Sheep and wolves have new clothes to wear!!!
notes.content:
[May 8] In this update, the sheep, wolves, and the walls have more choice in their appearance, to make this game scene colorful. Each new appearance can be unlocked by getting 4~6 golden stars.
You can turn on or off the new appearance in the [Stage Selection] panel.
Some options have also been added to make the game mechanism more interesting,
and you can interact with all the items placed on the title page.
Enjoy yourself :)

notes.title: Small Update on May 2, 2022
notes.content:
[1] Add interaction with the tree and the sheep on the title page.
[2] Replace the "Undo" button in the upper left corner with the "Restart" button, because "Undo" can be directly performed by right clicking, and this button is used less frequently than a "Clear All" button.

notes.title: Game Update (April 1st, 2022)
notes.content:
[b][Hint System][/b] Add a hint system:
According to the feedback of some players, there is no clue at some levels.

The hint system will be turned on 20-30 seconds after the stage begins. Click the light bulb on the pause panel to obtain a hint. (Approximate outline of the fences, for reference only)
( There is no hint for hidden stages! )
( Restarting a game will reset the timer! )

The hint system provides an "easy" mode to clear the stages. However, to unlock achievements or get the golden stars, you need to come up with other solutions.

[b][Retry Button][/b] Change the function of retry button to "undo the last operation".
If you want to explore a simpler solution after passing a level, you can click it.
